posts.title: Super CD-ROM² Required
posts.description: Whenever I start writing an emulator for a new system, there is always at least one game I’d really love to see running in my own emulator. If there wasn’t, I don’t think I’d be able to find the motivation to get to the point of some games kind of hopefully maybe mostly working.

posts.title: Trying to Make a Loop Auto-Vectorize
posts.description: This post assumes at least a vague level of familiarity with the concept of SIMD CPU instructions (x86 SSE/AVX and ARM Neon), where the CPU can perform a single operation on multiple scalar values simultaneously. There is a lot of x86 assembly here to demonstrate what’s happening but you don’t have to be able to read it.

posts.title: Emulator Bugs: Genesis Grab Bag
posts.description: This post covers a few Genesis emulation bugs that I ran into at various points, that I don’t think are substantial enough to justify their own posts (barring maybe the third one).
